E0330

Leading-dot enum variant (`.Variant`) with no inferable type from context

What

Leading-dot enum variant (`.Variant`) with no inferable type from context

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Provide a type context for the leading-dot enum variant.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0330: tests/ui/enum_dot_no_context.stderr.

Error [jet.UninferableEnumCase]: Can't infer the enum type for `.Red`
  --> tests/ui/enum_dot_no_context.jet:2:10
    |
  2 |     x := .Red
    |          ^^^^
 Why: A leading-dot variant needs a known enum type from context
 Fix: Write the full form `EnumName.Red`, or use it where its enum type is already expected
